angleEvidenceBrief: The page draws the eight recorded routes as ribbons whose width is their volume, so Lisboa-London is visibly the widest, and states the arriving total per destination on the map and in a table that is visible without any interaction, so Paris at 23,600 against London at 21,200 is readable at rest. Both are the storyboard slot own proves.
reviewer: journalist (decision taken in this run, recorded in APPROVED.md)
notes: Second review, bound to the render that carries the live map. The first render declared its live container as id mw-live-map; live-map.mjs looks for mw-map and returns null without a word, so that build shipped with zero network requests and the fallback plate forever. Verified by driving a keyed copy in a real browser: 13 requests to api.maptiler.com, canvas present, fallback hidden, eight ribbons and eight arrowheads painted on the live layer.
